text.text: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.
For the ear of jealousy heareth all things: and the noise of murmurings is not hid.
Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace.
Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
